communicate.title: Communicate

about.title: Citiz exists to be useful.
about.subtitle: A free, open-source, multilingual, privacy-first companion for people preparing for United States citizenship.
about.m.free: Citiz is free, because access to civic knowledge should not depend on the ability to pay.
about.m.multilingual: Citiz is multilingual, because learning English should not stop you from understanding the instructions.
about.m.everywhere: Citiz is cross-platform, because everyone should be able to study on the device they already own.
about.m.private: Citiz protects privacy, because preparing for citizenship should not require handing over sensitive immigration information.
about.m.transparent: Citiz is transparent, because software should explain, not impose conclusions.
about.m.community: Citiz is community-driven, because knowing a nation also means knowing and supporting its communities.
about.principleText: Software may teach, explain, connect ideas and personalize. It never invents an official answer or a historical fact. Every fact Citiz shows carries its source and its verification status.
about.independence: Citiz is an independent educational tool. It is not affiliated with USCIS or any government agency, it does not give legal advice, and it cannot guarantee the outcome of an interview or application.
about.openSourceText: Code, content and translations are public. Fix a fact, add a language, or build a feature.
